| PP-05 | the front end's input capacitors' ripple rating | a maker's ripple current and DC-bias figure for the input capacitors at 36 V, at or above the demand at the front end's maximum | 6 | L3-C41 | R11-DEPENDENCY.md section 7a, branch fnd/l3plane at 4e9fa869 (stream r11dep's first issue, checked once and not accepted) item 7 |

**Remedies that would change a requirement, if an engineer chose them instead of the engineering form.** None is asked now (D-25): each correction above has an engineering form that changes no requirement. Each case names the requirement and its consequence.

| Remedy | Requirement it changes | Consequence |
|---|---|---|
| Raise the full-current input floor so that L1 needs no new part and no schedule (B-1, PP-03) | REQ-015: 'A 9 to 36 V vehicle and shore input runs the kit and charges the pack' | full charge current needs VIN_RAW of 11.00 V or more, so vehicle and shore inputs from 9 to 11 V (a 12 V system's low end) leave full service; on the reference day the tracker holds 15.1 V and no energy is lost; the charge when capped instead is the basis's figure (HELD) |
| Cap U3's input limit below 6.2 A permanently (B-1 to B-4) | REQ-072 (M1) | HELD for the checked basis: the lowest store falls with the cap (ENERGY-BASIS.md section 4), and the derated variant fails M1 on every lid (four_cases) |
| A part or a bank that does not fit board A's place (B-1, B-2, B-4) | CON-006 (the pack pocket bounded by board A's east edge), or REQ-019 (the case never changes) if it went further | not quantified: no part is selected; the question arises only if no fitting part exists |

## Row L3-OD6's options, quantified

Each figure is null (HELD) until the energy basis is filed with an accepted check; then fill_l3r2_from_basis.py writes it from weather_basis.out B by the exact key of its basis and build (basis_reader.py), with `evidence` naming the output and its section, and od_l3_6.py reads the filed output again and compares every figure before it writes an answer. Cells, mass and volume are the cells' own (Samsung INR18650-35E, 12.06 Wh and 50 g a cell): holders, protection boards, wiring and enclosures are not counted. Usable energy is nominal times the basis's allowances (ageing to 80 percent, the 3.00 V line with its reserve, rate and temperature), stated with the figures. `fits` lists the lids that carry the store: tablet-out (4S14P, 80 cells), qmx-out (4S15P, 84 cells, also the QMX outside) and both-kept (4S9P, 60 cells).

## Applying an answer

Each row has a prepared registry restatement, not applied: `python3 v2/docs/records/l3r2/conditional/<script> --option <option> --words "<the owner's words>" --date <YYYY-MM-DD>` records his answer as an owner ruling that names the row and applies the exact registry change; `--check` does the same in memory and writes nothing. A row whose `requires` is not met is refused. After a script: `rules_lib.py requirements`, `rules_render.py --requirements` and this renderer.

| Row | Script | Options | Requires | Held until |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| L3-OD1 | `od_l3_1.py` | `approve`; `reject` | none | l3r2.yaml `energy_basis` filed, l3r2.yaml `power_path_check` filed |
| L3-OD2 | `od_l3_2.py` | `qmx-out`; `qmx-outside` (also held until `relocation_facts`); `tablet-out`; `both-kept` | L3-OD1:approve | l3r2.yaml `energy_basis` filed, l3r2.yaml `power_path_check` filed |
| L3-OD3 | `od_l3_3.py` | `2s2p`; `1s4p`; `keep` | L3-OD1:approve | nothing |
| L3-OD4 | `od_l3_4.py` | `adopt`; `reject` | L3-OD1:approve, L3-OD2:*, L3-OD3:2s2p and L3-OD6:mean-day (adopt) or any (reject) | l3r2.yaml `energy_basis` filed, l3r2.yaml `power_path_check` filed |
| L3-OD5 | `od_l3_5.py` | `reading-c`; `measure`; `cells` | none | nothing |
| L3-OD6 | `od_l3_6.py` | `mean-day`; `coverage` | none | l3r2.yaml `energy_basis` filed, l3r2.yaml `power_path_check` filed |

## The combinations the evidence covers

The prepared scripts refuse a combination outside these rules, and the completion gate reads the target unambiguous only on one inside them (CHECK-1, B1).

| Rule | Why |
|---|---|
| row L3-OD1 answered approve | rows L3-OD2 to L3-OD4 need it; a reject records an open conflict instead |
| row L3-OD4 answered adopt only with row L3-OD3 answered 2s2p | the plane grid ran 400 Wp in 2S2P into 200 W; no band exists for 1S4P or for REQ-016 kept |
| row L3-OD4 answered adopt only with row L3-OD2 not answered both-kept | M1 is not met with a 4S9P lid, so no band is adopted for it |
| row L3-OD4 answered adopt only after row L3-OD6 answered mean-day | the plane grid runs SC-37's mean day on each plane; no band exists for a coverage target, and a band adopted first would select the benchmark without the owner (D-23; CHECK-2, B1) |
| row L3-OD2's lid carries the store of row L3-OD6's answer in its build case | row L3-OD6's table marks per lid which carries each basis (weather_basis.out B); a lid it does not mark, or a fit not yet filled, is not a coherent set, and the scripts record an open conflict against REQ-072 (CHECK-2, B2) |
| one ruling on the array | row L3-OD1 fixes no array; row L3-OD3 alone does, and od_l3_3.py replaces REQ-072's marked phrase with it |
